canonical.title: IT conferences and tech events in (and near) Menton

parent.title: A weekend in Menton, anchored on a Michelin-starred dinner

siblings.title: Things to do in Menton
siblings.summary: Weekend playbook for Menton (Alpes-Maritimes): Old Town loop, jardins remarquables, Cocteau status, beaches, lemon trail and easy half-day trips.

siblings.title: Michelin 2 and 3-star restaurants in Menton
siblings.summary: Menton itself has one Michelin-starred restaurant at 2★ or 3★: Mirazur (3★). No 2★ in town — the nearest sit a ~15-min drive away.

sources.title: Palais de l'Europe — Menton Congrès
sources.claim: Menton's Congress Bureau lists medical/scientific congresses (JAS, PILM, ICQC, IWOAI) but no IT or tech events.

sources.title: Journées de l'Architecture en Santé
sources.claim: JAS is held annually at the Palais de l'Europe in Menton — a healthcare-building congress, not IT.

sources.title: JAS 7e édition — Architecture Hospitalière
sources.claim: JAS in Menton runs at the Palais de l'Europe in October each year.

sources.title: Sciences Po Menton campus
sources.claim: Sciences Po Menton hosts conferences focused on Middle East / Mediterranean politics.

sources.title: Ready For IT 2026 — Grimaldi Forum
sources.claim: Ready For IT 2026 — CIOs/CISOs/CTOs on digital transition and cybersecurity, 2–4 June 2026.

sources.title: Ready For IT 2026 — Banque des Territoires
sources.claim: Ready For IT 2026 gathers 200+ IT decision-makers around pre-arranged one-to-one meetings.

sources.title: WAIB Summit Monaco
sources.claim: WAIB Summit Monaco — Web3, AI and digital assets summit at One Monte-Carlo, 9–10 June 2026.

sources.title: WAIB Summit — Monaco Life
sources.claim: WAIB Summit confirmed institutional participation: BNP Paribas, Franklin Templeton, EU Commission and Parliament.

sources.title: World AI Cannes Festival (WAICF)
sources.claim: WAICF 2026 — Palais des Festivals, Cannes, 12–13 February 2026, with 10,000+ visitors and 320 speakers.

sources.title: WAiFF — Palais des Festivals Cannes
sources.claim: World AI Film Festival (WAiFF) — Cannes, 21–22 April 2026.

sources.title: Cray User Group 2026
sources.claim: CUG 2026 — HPC and AI at Le Méridien Nice, 26–30 April 2026, theme "Science for Society".

sources.title: Riviera DEV 2026
sources.claim: Riviera DEV 2026 — developer conference at SKEMA Sophia Antipolis, 6–8 July 2026.

sources.title: Azur Tech Summer 2026 — Telecom Valley
sources.claim: Azur Tech Summer 2026 — Telecom Valley's regional digital-industry event, SKEMA Sophia Antipolis, 2 July 2026.

sources.title: ETSI Security Conference 2026
sources.claim: ETSI Security Conference 2026 — 20th edition, 19–22 October at ETSI HQ Sophia Antipolis; agentic AI, quantum-safe crypto, Zero Trust.

sources.title: ETSI AI and Data Conference 2026
sources.claim: ETSI AI and Data Conference 2026 — 9–11 February at ETSI Sophia Antipolis.

sources.title: ETSI UCAAT 2026
sources.claim: ETSI UCAAT 2026 — automated testing, 12th edition, Sophia Antipolis, 14–16 April 2026.

sources.title: IASP World Conference 2026
sources.claim: IASP World Conference 2026 — 27–30 October at Palais des Festivals Cannes, with Sophia Antipolis technical tours.

sources.title: Monaco — Menton train times (Trainline)
sources.claim: Monaco–Menton: 10–11 minutes by direct train, 46 services per day.

sources.title: Nice — Menton train times (Trainline)
sources.claim: Nice–Menton: ~36 minutes average (32 fastest), 46 direct services per day.

sources.title: Cannes — Menton train times (Trainline)
sources.claim: Cannes–Menton: 1h09 fastest, 1h27 average, 42 direct services per day.

sources.title: Sophia Antipolis — Nice (Moovit)
sources.claim: Sophia Antipolis is inland near Antibes — needs train + bus from the coastal line.

sources.title: French Riviera Software Craftsmanship Community
